answer: In arXiv 2501.10391, the existing ontologies identified as most relevant for the AI Act are AIRO (AI Risk Ontology) and VAIR (Vocabulary of AI Risks). Their integration into the Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) is described as follows: the DPVCG is currently integrating AIRO and VAIR into the AI and AI Act extensions of the DPV. The DPV is noted to be the only resource that has modeled the GDPR and has been expanded to also model the AI Act using the same core concepts.
